sloka: स त्वम् धर्म परो भूत्वा काश्यपाय वसुंधराम् ।दत्त्वा वनम् उपागम्य महेन्द्र कृत केतनः ॥१-७५-८॥
transliteration: sa tvam dharma paro bhūtvā kāśyapāya vasuṁdharām ।dattvā vanam upāgamya mahendra kṛta ketanaḥ ॥1-75-8॥

translations.english: By adhering to righteousness in life and having conferred the earth upon Kasyapa, you retired to the forest and made your residence on the Mahendra mountain.
